    anchor = seg['anchor']
    if seg['first']['source'] == 'INITIAL_FRAME':
        start = -1  # before t0
    else:
        start = seg['first']['transition_id']
    end = seg['last']['transition_id']
    for t in range(start+1, end+1):
        pos_at_t[t] = anchor

# Now show action -> delta mapping

for t in range(len(actions)):
    act = actions[t]
    if t > 0 and t in pos_at_t and (t-1) in pos_at_t:
        prev = pos_at_t[t-1]
        curr = pos_at_t[t]
        dr = curr[0] - prev[0]
        dc = curr[1] - prev[1]
        if dr != 0 or dc != 0:
            print(f"  t{t}: {act} from {prev} to {curr} (dr={dr}, dc={dc})")
    elif t == 0 and t in pos_at_t:
        print(f"  t{t}: {act} initial pos {pos_at_t[t]}")
